rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
# temporary work-around, this has been fixed upstream sed -i 's@# include <asm/sigcontext.h>@@g' os_dep.c
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -D_GNU_SOURCE -DNO_GETCONTEXT -DUSE_MMAP -DHAVE_DL_ITERATE_PHDR"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --localstatedir=/var/lib \ --enable-cplusplus \ --enable-static
